definitions.explanation: The ceremonial head of state and symbol of the Japanese nation and unity of the people.

examples.japanese: {天皇|てんのう}{陛下|へいか}がお{言葉|ことば}を{述|の}べられた。
examples.english: His Majesty the Emperor delivered an address.

examples.japanese: {天皇|てんのう}{誕生日|たんじょうび}は{祝日|しゅくじつ}だ。
examples.english: The Emperor's birthday is a national holiday.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{天皇|てんのう}が{即位|そくい}された。

notes:
{天皇|てんのう} refers specifically to the Japanese Emperor.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {天皇|てんのう}{陛下|へいか}: His Majesty the Emperor
- {天皇|てんのう}{誕生日|たんじょうび}: Emperor's Birthday (national holiday)
- {上皇|じょうこう}: Emperor Emeritus
- {皇后|こうごう}: Empress

HISTORICAL NOTE:
The Imperial line is considered the oldest continuous hereditary monarchy in the world.

RELATED TERMS:
- {皇室|こうしつ}: Imperial family
- {即位|そくい}: enthronement
- {元号|げんごう}: era name
